text:
Type: round extendable dining table on pedestal
Use: dining, family meals, seating extra guests; dining room, kitchen
Style: classic, traditional, farmhouse
Materials: black stained solid wood, wood-based top, turned wood pedestal base
Colors: black, deep black-brown
Shape: round top with a profiled edge and deep apron, center leaf for an oval shape, turned column pedestal on four curved feet, solid and grounded
Feel: cozy, elegant, sturdy, timeless
Goes with: painted or wood windsor chairs, cream walls, rugs; classic kitchens and farmhouse dining rooms
